ensemble.note: Positional accuracy = total_position_hits / (draws × 6). Random baseline expectation ≈ 10% (1/10 per digit position). Lottery outcomes are inherently unpredictable.

random_baseline.note: Positional accuracy = total_position_hits / (draws × 6). Random baseline expectation ≈ 10% (1/10 per digit position). Lottery outcomes are inherently unpredictable.

comparison.interpretation: Positive lift = model captures some signal above chance. Near-zero or negative lift = no reliable predictive edge. Lottery draws are designed to be uniformly random.
